questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I wonder if the postman _____ today.
questions.solution: The correct answer is **'will come'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate option for the given blank is** 'will come'.** • The given sentence is an example of the **first conditional.** • The structure of these kinds of sentences is: • If+Present Indefinite, Simple Future​ • Example:* If he works hard, he will surely get the job.* • Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.** **Correct Sentence:__** *I wonder if the postman **will come** today.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** __ • An **if-** or **when-clause** generally does not contain “will"__, which is the simple future tense of the verb “to be.” [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] __Confusion Points__ __ • **Exception 1: **When the action in the if- or when-clause__ **takes place after that in the main clause. ** • Example:* If paracetamol **will **ease my fever, I **will **take one tonight instead of this medicine.* __ • Exception 2: When “will” is not being used as a helping verb but as a modal verb or we can say “will” is used in the if- clause__ when **it is being used to politely express willingness, persistence, or a wish**. • Example:* I think I **will **warm some water for tea if you **will **excuse me.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__ • दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प **'will come' **है। • दिया गया वाक्य **first conditional **का उदाहरण है। • इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना है: • If+Present Indefinite, Simple Future​ • Example:* If he works hard, he will surely get the job.* • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3 **है। 31:T9a9, The correct answer is '**Hoot**'.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Her later short stories are vastly __superior than__ her earlier ones.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. superior to .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**superior**" is always followed by the preposition "**to**" when used to compare two things or people.
 
• Using "**than**" or other prepositions such as "from," "over," or "against" with "superior" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Therefore, the correct substitution for the underlined segment "*superior than*" is "**superior to**."

Correct sentence: *Her later short stories are vastly **superior to** her earlier ones*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The adjectives "**inferior**," "**senior**," "**junior**," "**prior**," and "**preferable**" also take the preposition "**to**" instead of "**than**" when making comparisons.
 
• **Example:** He is junior to me in the office, not "junior than me."
